neighbours.label: the first piece of a word the tokenizer splits, mostly ' bl' / ' be' / ' dr' (bl|ight, be|vy, dr|ab)
fire: Farmers feared the blight would ruin the potato harvest again.
The aunt bequeathed her farmhouse to the village library.
A bevy of reporters waited outside the courthouse.
The blimp drifted slowly over the football stadium.
His drab gray coat hung near the door all winter.
One small blunder cost the team the championship.
The publisher wrote a short blurb for the back cover.
Years of drudgery at the mill wore him down.
quiet: Farmers feared the drought would ruin the potato harvest again.
The aunt left her farmhouse to the village library.
A crowd of reporters waited outside the courthouse.
The balloon drifted slowly over the football stadium.
His black wool coat hung near the door all winter.
One small bluff cost the team the championship.
The publisher wrote a short note for the back cover.
Years of hard labor at the mill wore him down.

notes: probes: beagle/blizzard/drizzle (split) fire, bride (single token) does not. Fire words checked with the tokenizer to split as ' bl'/' be'/' dr' + rest; near misses use single-token words with the same onset.
